QF.id: AIFM Fund Monitoring, Reporting, and Exit_21

question.text: In the CTR, one check verifies that each scheme of the AIF has a minimum corpus of:

answer.text: INR 100 crore, with carve-out for accredited investors

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI (AIF) Regulations, the minimum scheme corpus is INR 20 crore. The CTR includes an explicit check confirming each scheme's corpus meets this floor. (Minimum investor commitment is a separate INR 1 cr, with AI waiver.) The Trap: INR 10 / 50 / 100 cr are plausible distractors from other SEBI regimes (PMS minimum, angel-fund limits). Only INR 20 cr matches the AIF rule. Cross-Exam Context: III-A and XIX-A/B test the INR 20 cr rule. XIX-C expects you to know it as a CTR line item.
